args.description: Game prop reference of the ruin from the reference image, seen in a three-quarter view with one corner toward the camera, at the game's camera angle, slightly from above, like the reference image. The reference shows no ruin: it is only a patch of keep masonry whose palette the ruin must match; draw only one ruin and nothing else, no tower, no figures; use the reference only for the colours of the stone. Same design: broken grey-brown masonry of large dressed stone blocks, the same courses as a keep wall, darker in the cracks and lighter on the lit faces. A short broken wall stub, about as tall as it is wide, a few courses of stone with a jagged broken top. Match the rendering style of the second reference image exactly: the same chunky voxel pixel-art look, block size, outline-free shading and soft lighting, but not its subject. The whole ruin from its top to the ground it stands on, upright, centred, nothing cropped. Plain flat white background, no ground, no grass, no shadow, no text, no other objects. One single ruin only, not a sheet of several.
